=={{header|Ada}}==
{{libheader|Simple components for Ada}}
There is no need to parse anything in Ada because JSON pointer is an expression there. No tilde escaping is needed too, because the JSON name is written as a string. In the solution below when string is expected then it is printed directly as is. It could also be queried as a JSON object like in the case of "abc" array. The language supports overloading in the result, therefore the compiler can decide which type to take depending on the context.
<syntaxhighlight lang="Ada">
with Ada.Text_IO;                 use Ada.Text_IO;
with Parsers.JSON;                use Parsers.JSON;
with Parsers.JSON.String_Source;  use Parsers.JSON.String_Source;
with Parsers.String_Source;       use Parsers.String_Source;
with Stack_Storage;

procedure JSON_Pointer is
   Text : aliased String :=
          "{"                                                        &
           """wiki"": {"                                             &
            """links"": ["                                           &
              """https://rosettacode.org/wiki/Rosetta_Code"","       &
              """https://discord.com/channels/1011262808001880065""" &
             "]"                                                     &
           "},"                                                      &
           """"": ""Rosetta"","                                      &
           """ "": ""Code"","                                        &
           """g/h"": ""chrestomathy"","                              &
           """i~j"": ""site"","                                      &
           """abc"": [""is"", ""a""],"                               &
           """def"": { """": ""programming"" }"                      &
          "}";
   Arena : aliased Stack_Storage.Pool (200, 512);
   Input : aliased Source (Text'Access);
   Data  : constant JSON_Value := Parse (Input'Access, Arena'Access);
begin
   Put_Line (Image (Data));
   Put_Line (Data / "");
   Put_Line (Data / " ");
   Put_Line (Data / "i~j");
   Put_Line (Image (JSON_Value'(Data / "abc")));
   Put_Line (Data / "def" / "");
   Put_Line (Data / "wiki" / "links" / 1); -- In Ada we use 1-based arrays
   Put_Line (Data / "wiki" / "links" / 2);
   begin
      Put_Line (Data / "wiki" / "links" / 3);
   exception
      when Constraint_Error =>
         Put_Line ("invalid path");
   end;
end JSON_Pointer;
</syntaxhighlight>
{{out}}
<pre style="height:20ex;overflow:scroll;overflow-wrap;normal;word-wrap:normal;white-space:pre;">
{"wiki":{"links":["https://rosettacode.org/wiki/Rosetta_Code","https://discord.com/channels/1011262808001880065"]},"":"Rosetta"," ":"Code","g/h":"chrestomathy","i~j":"site","abc":["is","a"],"def":{"":"programming"}}
Rosetta
Code
site
["is","a"]
programming
